answer: Answering and grading must be capped separately so a farm cannot move all of its weight onto whichever role pays more that hour. If both caps bind, then doubling accounts is the only way to raise the take, which again multiplies bonds, vests, and exposure. The cap math does not change when the brief cites dawn, harbor, and tide. Role-shifting is a common Sybil trick; split ceilings close that bypass.
